EAGLE MOUNTAIN CITY 
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARINGS 

The Eagle Mountain Planning Commission will hold public hearings on June 9, 2026, at 6:30 
p.m., or as soon thereafter as business allows, in the Eagle Mountain City Council 
Chambers, located at 1650 E. Stagecoach Run, Eagle Mountain, Utah 84005.  The Planning 
Commission will receive public comments concerning the following items: 
Second Amendment to the Master Development Agreement for Eagle Quest East: Planning 
Commission recommendation on a proposed second amendment to the Eagle Quest East 

Master Development Agreement that would extend the initial benchmarks of development and 
the overall expiration of the Agreement. The project is located on Parcel No. 59:006:0053, which 
is just north of the Sunset Flats development. EMC Point of Contact: Steven Lehmitz, 
slehmitz@eaglemountain.gov. 

Consolidated Fee Schedule Amendment: Planning Commission review and recommendation 
of a proposed amendment to the City's Consolidated Fee Schedule Section 13 Building 
Department Fees, 10.7 Other Subdivision Development Fees and Appendix B Building Valuation 
Table.  EMC Point of Contact: Brandon Larsen, blarsen@eaglemountain.gov.

Senior Housing Overlay Zone/EMMC 17.10.030, 17.25.030, and 17.55: A proposal to add 
definitions, amend the Residential Development Standards table, and enact EMMC 17.55 to 
establish a Senior Housing Overlay Zone and the associated standards. EMC Staff Points of Contact: 
Elizabeth Fewkes, efewkes@eaglemountain.gov; and Kiara Polee, kpolee@eaglemountain.gov. 

Materials for the public hearing items may be viewed within three days of the meeting on the city 
website and at the Eagle Mountain City Recorder's Office, 1650 E Stagecoach Run, Eagle Mountain,

accommodation to participate in the meeting, please call the City Recorder's Office at 801.789.6611.  
Open portions of the meeting can be viewed at www.eaglemountain.gov.

notices.agenda_text:
EAGLE MOUNTAIN CITY 
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARINGS 

The Eagle Mountain Planning Commission will hold a hearing for affected entities on June 9, 
2026, at 6:30 p.m., or as soon thereafter as business allows, in the Eagle Mountain City 
Council Chambers, located at 1650 E. Stagecoach Run, Eagle Mountain, Utah 84005.  The 
Planning Commission will receive comments concerning the following item: 
Annexation Policy Plan: Eagle Mountain City is proposing an updated annexation 
policy plan and is seeking feedback from affected entities, as defined in §10-2-801 of 
the Utah Code Annotated - including special districts or special service districts 
whose boundary includes any part of an area proposed for annexation; a school 
district whose boundary includes any part of an area proposed for annexation, if the 
boundary is proposed to be adjusted as a result of the annexation; and a municipality 
whose boundaries are within 1/2 mile of an area proposed for annexation. This is a 
public meeting in which the City is seeking feedback from affected entities at this 
point of the proposed annexation policy plan update process. Affected entities will 
also have ten (10) additional days, after the public meeting, to submit written 
feedback to the Planning Commission for consideration. EMC Point of Contact: 
Community Development Director, Brandon Larsen: blarsen@eaglemountain.gov. 

Materials for the public hearing items may be viewed within three days of the meeting on the city 
website and at the Eagle Mountain City Recorder's Office, 1650 E Stagecoach Run, Eagle Mountain, 
UT, during normal business hours, Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM. If you need special 
accommodation to participate in the meeting, please call the City Recorder's Office at 801.789.6611.  
Open portions of the meeting can be viewed at www.eaglemountain.gov. 
AFFECTED ENTITIES ARE INVITED TO PARTICIPATE IN THIS MEETING.

notices.agenda_text:
EAGLE MOUNTAIN CITY
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARINGS
The Eagle Mountain Planning Commission will hold public hearings on May 12, 2026, at 6:30
p.m., or as soon thereafter as business allows, in the Eagle Mountain City Council 
Chambers, located at 1650 E. Stagecoach Run, Eagle Mountain, Utah 84005. The Planning 
Commission will receive public comments concerning the following items:
Overland ARMDA Amendment: On March 25th, 2026, the City Council approved the 
5th Amendment to the Overland ARMDA with Terra Smith's Eagle Mountain, LLC. Prior to 
execution of the Amendment the developer determined that it would like to add another 
party to the agreement, Smith's Food & Drug Center, Inc., and to request one additional 
exception to a City development standard in relation to slope requirements for retention 
basins. The amendment is being sought to make those changes and to correct a clerical error 
in the agreement that gives the incorrect name of Terra Smith's Eagle Mountain, LLC. EMC 
Point of Contact: Marcus Draper, mdraper@eaglemountain.gov.
Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Amendments: 
EMMC 16.15: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain 
Municipal Code Chapter 16.15 Concept Plans. EMC Point of Contact: Brandon Larsen, 
blarsen@eaglemountain.gov.
EMMC 17.64 - Alternative Energy Overlay Zone: Eagle Mountain City is proposing the 
creation of an overlay zone known as the Alternative Energy Overlay Zone (AEOZ) which 
would allow for the development of a variety of types of power generation facilities at 
approved locations. The AEOZ is not being proposed at this time to be applied to any property 
and would generally be contemplated for use on request. The AEOZ contains a number of 
requirements and restrictions regarding power generation facility development including 
demonstration of approval from state and federal entities as applicable. EMC Staff Point of 
Contact: Evan Berrett, eberrett@eaglemountain.gov.
Materials for the public hearing items may be viewed within three days of the meeting on the city 
website and at the Eagle Mountain City Recorder's Office, 1650 E Stagecoach Run, Eagle Mountain, 
UT, during normal business hours, Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM. If you need special 
accommodation to participate in the meeting, please call the City Recorder's Office at 801.789.6611. 
Open portions of the meeting can be viewed at www.eaglemountain.gov.
THE PUBLIC IS INVITED TO PARTICIPATE IN ALL PUBLIC MEETINGS
